test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_json_v2 (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 0)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_map (id UInt64, m Map(String, String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS map_serialization_version = 'with_buckets', map_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts = 'with_buckets', map_buckets_strategy = 'constant', max_buckets_in_map = 16, map_buckets_min_avg_size = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_prewhere_json_v2 SELECT number, concat('{{"kind":"a","n":', toString(number), ',"payload":"', repeat('x', 2000), '"}}') FROM numbers_mt(3000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 62500, min_insert_block_size_rows = 125000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 24 OR min(rows) != 125000 OR max(rows) != 125000 OR max(level) != 0) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 't_prewhere_json_v2' AND active
INSERT INTO t_prewhere_map SELECT number, mapFromArrays(arrayMap(i -> 'k' || toString(i), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> repeat('v', 60), range(16))) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
